head: edd757f7
sequenceNote: Implements world-map control parity first, then hydrology/cave coherence, followed by protocol validation and utility hardening.

server.name: world-map-control-parity
server.notes: Keep streamed profile hash aligned with JSON world config; share hydrology/cave tuning across server/client previews.

server.name: hydrology-envelope
server.notes: Stabilize rivers, lakes, and caves with gradient/edge passes before carving; reduce chunk seam artifacts.

server.name: protocol-registry-validation
server.notes: Verify generated EnhancedMinecraft DTOs and handler bindings on startup; surface missing packet coverage.

client.name: world-map-preview-parity
client.notes: Unity preview reuses server hydrology/cave params with gradient stability; reloads profile JSON hash.

client.name: protocol-client-bindings
client.notes: Ensure client protobuf DTO references mirror SharedProtocol registry and server dispatch.

server.name: cave-river-lake-coherence
server.notes: Hydrology-driven carving with seam-aware smoothing and riparian plugs; keeps subterranean water aligned.

client.name: map-visualization
client.notes: Display stabilized rivers/lakes/caves from control profile; mirror erosion/outflow tuning.

server.name: data-driven-config-refresh
server.notes: JSON-backed config loader with checksum logging; feeds world map control generation.

client.name: streaming-profile-hotload
client.notes: Hot-reloads map-control JSON and resets preview generator when hash/signature changes.
